text: Exponential backoff delays retries by base times two to the attempt number. Cap delays and attempts to avoid endless loops.
LangGraph checkpoints persist graph state per thread. Resume an interrupted thread with the same thread identifier.
Tools can execute again after a crash before checkpoint commit. Use idempotency keys for external writes.
Every tool needs a deadline. Cancel asynchronous I/O and kill computation subprocesses on timeout.
A fallback uses an alternate source or capability. Local knowledge cannot establish current web facts.
Reflection checks relevance and completeness of evidence, not merely successful tool execution.
Escalation honestly reports incomplete work, failed approaches, and the help needed to continue.
The Python sandbox uses Linux seccomp to deny filesystem opens and networking, with CPU and memory limits.
TF-IDF represents documents as sparse lexical vectors. Cosine similarity ranks query matches without a paid embedding API.
SQLite stores checkpoints on local disk. A persistent volume is required to survive container replacement.
Structured event logs record node names, routing decisions, and concise reasons. They do not expose private model reasoning.
A plan is a bounded ordered sequence of tool calls. Replanning preserves completed evidence and replaces remaining work.
